title: tricalysia boiviniana
intro: Tricalysia boiviniana, commonly known as Boivin's Tricalysia, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been used for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tricalysia boiviniana include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as its antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, such as quercetin and kaempferol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
